# @ndigo/boot

Application bootstrap, profiles, and typed configuration for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/boot/schema/application.schema.json`

## Public exports

- `Application` — Class that can be used to bootstrap and launch an application.
- `FromConfigOptions` *(type)* — Options for `ApplicationBuilder.fromConfig`.
- `ApplicationBuilder` — Builder for configuring and running an application bootstrap sequence.
- `ConfigurationPropertiesOptions` *(type)* — Options for configurationProperties.
- `configurationProperties` — Marks a class as a configuration properties holder and optionally sets a property key prefix.
- `isConfigurationProperties` — Utility to check if a class is decorated with `@configurationProperties`.
- `getConfigurationPropertiesPrefix` — Reads the optional prefix from a `@configurationProperties` class.
- `property`
- `defaultValue`
- `relaxedKeyCandidates`
- `nestedConfig`
- `DeclaredConfigurationProperty` *(type)*
- `ConfigurationPropertiesResult` *(type)* — Result of resolving a configuration properties class against an application context.
- `resolveConfigurationProperties` — Resolves a `@configurationProperties` class against an application context, binding each `@property` field to its converted value from the environment.

- `mergeConfig` — Recursively merges `override` into `base` (mutates a copy of `base`): objects merge, scalars override, **arrays replace**.
